edges.reason: ChangeOwner writes the owner state variable.
AddModerator writes the moderators mapping.
AddModerator increments totalModerators without SafeMath.
RemoveModerator writes the moderators mapping.
RemoveModerator decrements totalModerators, wrapping at zero.
AddModerator performs unchecked uint16 counter increment.
RemoveModerator performs unchecked uint16 counter decrement.
msg.sender must equal owner for the onlyOwner guard on ChangeOwner.
msg.sender must equal owner for the onlyOwner guard on AddModerator.
msg.sender must equal owner for the onlyOwner guard on RemoveModerator.
owner is compared with msg.sender in ChangeOwner.
owner is compared with msg.sender in AddModerator.
owner is compared with msg.sender in RemoveModerator.
_canOperate reads ownerToOperators for operator authorization.
_canOperate compares the token owner with msg.sender.
_canTransfer authorizes msg.sender, approved address or operator.
_canTransfer reads idToApprovals.
_canTransfer reads ownerToOperators.
_canTransfer queries the battle contract for on-battle status.
_canTransfer queries the trade contract for on-trading status.
setOperationContracts rewrites dataContract.
setOperationContracts rewrites battleContract.
setOperationContracts rewrites tradeContract.
withdrawEther performs an external ETH transfer via _sendTo.transfer.
The recipient fallback could re-enter withdrawEther during the transfer.
_safeTransferFrom invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract.
A malicious receiver can re-enter _safeTransferFrom from the callback.
safeTransferFrom delegates to _safeTransferFrom.
_safeTransferFrom calls _transfer to move ownership.
transferFrom calls _canTransfer before moving the token.
transferFrom calls _transfer after successful checks.
_safeTransferFrom calls _canTransfer before moving the token.
approve calls _canOperate before writing the approval.
approve writes idToApprovals[_tokenId].
setApprovalForAll writes ownerToOperators[msg.sender].
_transfer clears the token approval through _clearApproval.
_transfer calls the data contract to update id mappings.
_burn clears the token approval.
catchMonster mutates the seed state from getRandom.
mintMonster mutates the seed state from getRandom.
mintMonster calls getRandom for stat generation.
catchMonster calls getRandom for stat generation.
catchMonster computes the price with unchecked multiplication and subtraction.
getPrice computes the price with unchecked multiplication and subtraction.
priceIncreasingRatio divides the unchecked price expression.
gapFactor is added to msg.value for the affordability check.

getPrice uses msg.sender to consult addressWhitelist.

catchMonster reads classWhitelist to gate non-catchable classes.

getPrice reads classWhitelist for the catchable override.

catchMonster mints a new monster increasing totalMonster in the data contract.

normalization_plan.reason: _sendTo is the recipient of the external ETH transfer inside withdrawEther.
_amount is only used in withdrawEther's balance check and transfer.
_player is only meaningful as the trainer argument of catchMonster.
_classId scopes the class lookup performed by catchMonster.
_name is only used when catchMonster creates the monster.
_objId identifies the monster handled by renameMonster.
name is only written by renameMonster through setMonsterObj.
_from is validated against obj.trainer only inside transferFrom.
_to is the recipient used by transferFrom when calling _transfer.
_tokenId is the token identity resolved by transferFrom.
_approved is written into idToApprovals only by approve.
_tokenId selects the approval slot written by approve.
_operator is the key written into ownerToOperators by setApprovalForAll.
_classId is only used by mintMonster when adding a monster object.
_trainer is the owner assigned by mintMonster to the new token.
_name is forwarded by mintMonster to addMonsterObj.
_classId is only used by getPrice to load the monster class.
_newOwner is the value assigned to owner by ChangeOwner.
_newModerator is the address written by AddModerator.
_oldModerator is the address cleared by RemoveModerator.
The MonsterObjAcc struct loaded in transfer paths supplies the trainer validated by _canTransfer.
The EtheremonDataBase instance is created next to the _canTransfer authorization flow.
The price local variable is produced by the unchecked price arithmetic.
objId is the identifier produced by addMonsterObj inside mintMonster.
value is the generated base stat byte computed inside mintMonster.
The MonsterClassAcc struct is loaded and consumed by getPrice.
The stats memory array only aggregates values for the price/stat getters.
